$comment: Output schema for EPA ProUCL 5.2 analysis. JSON object keyed by dataset name (CSV filename without .csv extension). All float values rounded to 4 decimal places.

uncensored_dataset_fields.se: float — standard error of the mean

gof.normal_pass: boolean — passes at ProUCL significance level
gof.gamma_pass: boolean — passes at ProUCL significance level
gof.lognormal_pass: boolean — passes at ProUCL significance level

uncensored_dataset_fields.distribution: string — one of: Normal, Gamma, Lognormal, Nonparametric
uncensored_dataset_fields.recommended_ucl: float — value of the recommended UCL

censored_dataset_fields.km_mean: float — estimated mean accounting for censoring
censored_dataset_fields.km_sd: float — estimated standard deviation accounting for censoring
censored_dataset_fields.km_se: float — estimated standard error accounting for censoring
censored_dataset_fields.km_S_final: float — residual survival probability below lowest observation
censored_dataset_fields.detected_mean: float — arithmetic mean of detected values only
censored_dataset_fields.dl_half_mean: float — mean using detection-limit/2 substitution for non-detects
censored_dataset_fields.distribution: string — distribution classification of detected values
censored_dataset_fields.recommended_ucl: float — value of the recommended UCL
